name: KCl sylvite
citation: D. Walker, P. K. Verma, L. M. D. Cranswick, R. L. Jones, S. M. Clark and S. Buhre (2004). Halite-sylvite thermoelasticity. American Mineralogist 89, 204-210.
conditions_evidence: CIF title/fields: sample msl515031, T=25 C, P=0.0 kbar. Zero denotes the reported ambient-pressure condition, not vacuum.
method: Experimental powder X-ray diffraction of the pure reagent KCl end-member; original article experimental methods describes Daresbury MSL rotating-anode source.
selection: Selected experimental reference; no FEFF calculation or experimental validation performed here.
notes: No occupancy column is supplied; full occupancy is the parser/default crystallographic interpretation, not a separately refined occupancy result.
Symmetry-fixed positions and the deposited experimental cell are retained; no coordinates, lattice constants or source bytes were modified.
Selected to avoid the unresolved historical-unit question in early KBr sources.
